guidance: AWS Shield Standard (free, default) covers L3/L4 attacks. Enable Shield Advanced for L7 protection against HTTP floods, DNS query floods, and TLS abuse, plus 24x7 DDoS Response Team access, cost protection during attacks, and unlimited WAF/Firewall Manager usage. Use Firewall Manager to automatically protect all ALBs and API Gateways. If using a third-party CDN (e.g., Cloudflare, Akamai), ensure L7 DDoS mitigation is explicitly included.
how_to_check: Is Shield Advanced enabled? Are all critical resources (ALBs, API Gateways, CloudFront) registered as protected? Are health checks and automatic remediation configured? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
